description: Create a record pre-filled from a record template: its preset values and its body (sections included). `values` overrides a preset, usually the title. A preset that no longer fits the schema (a deleted field or option) is dropped and listed in `skipped`, the record is still made. Returns the new record.

values.description: Field values keyed by api_name that win over the template's, e.g. { name: "Login fails on Safari" }.

name: create_record_from_template
title: Create a record from a template
